en.headline: APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting opens in Hong Kong for two days
en.dek: About 500 delegates from 21 economies gather at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, the first time the city has hosted the annual gathering.
body: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation Finance Ministers’ Meeting began in Hong Kong on Tuesday and runs through Wednesday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

China’s finance minister Lan Foan is hosting the sessions. Attendees include Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers, South Korea’s Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy Lee Hyoung-il, and Taiwan’s Minister of Finance Chuang Tsui-yun, according to reports from participating governments and local media.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is not attending; two deputies are representing the United States. Organisers expect discussions on regional economic outlook, digital infrastructure financing and other fiscal topics.
Hong Kong joined APEC in 1991. Mainland China is scheduled to host the APEC leaders’ summit in Shenzhen next month.

zh.headline: APEC財長會議今起兩日在香港會展舉行
zh.dek: 約500名來自21個經濟體的代表齊聚灣仔香港會議展覽中心，這是香港首次主辦這項年度財長會議。
body: 亞太經合組織財長會議周二起一連兩日在香港會議展覽中心舉行。
中國財政部長藍佛安主持會議。據參與政府及本地報道，出席者包括澳洲財政部長查默斯、南韓副總理兼財政經濟部長李炯日，以及台灣財政部長莊翠雲。
美國財長貝森特並未親身出席，由兩名副手代表美國。會議預計討論區域經濟展望、數碼基建融資等財政議題。
香港於1991年加入APEC。中國內地預定下月在深圳主辦APEC領袖峰會。
